'''Zerria's Bar''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] met with [[Goran Beviin]] there to discuss whether the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] should work for the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]].
